title: Finally Done
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：finally　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 finally 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Finally, in 1993 the herder settled the rope at the pen, and everybody in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of that morning: before the December rains the herder had ② finally settled the rope, and nobody had asked a single question. The herder had come to the pasture two winters earlier, and spoke little of the pasture he had left behind him.

The ledger for December 1987 puts it plainer. The rope was ③ finally calm, and the neighbour who kept it had ④ finally raised it twice before the winter came; nothing in the pasture was ever done finally in those days. The neighbour wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every winter thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant something else. He settled the rope ⑤ finally in the rain, and nobody in the pasture doubted it; of all who settled it that winter, he settled it ⑥ finally at once. He was not a man who explained himself, and the pasture had long since stopped asking him to.

By 2000 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was that the rope be raised ⑦ finally every winter, and that whoever did it be ⑧ finally careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done finally.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2003 she settled the rope ⑨ finally at once when nobody else would, and ⑩ Finally, she said in 2005, that was the part the pasture never forgot; the ledger still speaks finally of it. She kept the rope in the same pen for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the pasture never forgot how finally it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 终于（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had finally settled …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 终于（修饰形容词：finally calm）
C. adv. 最后（评注性状语，置于句首：Finally, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 最后（修饰过去分词：had finally raised it）
E. adv. 终于（句末状语：… finally in the rain）
F. adv. 终于（句末状语：… finally at once，第 6 处）
G. adv. 最后（被动结构中的中位状语：be raised finally）
H. adv. 最后（修饰形容词：be finally careful about the whole business）

items.q: finally in the rain, and nobody

answers.why: finally 意为“终于”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Finally, in 1993 …。
finally 意为“终于”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had finally settled the rope。
finally 意为“终于”，此处修饰形容词 calm（平静）：was finally calm。
finally 意为“最后”，此处修饰过去分词 raised：had finally raised it twice。
finally 意为“终于”，此处置于句末修饰动词：settled the rope finally in the rain。
finally 意为“终于”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 冬天, he did it finally at once。
finally 意为“最后”，被动结构 be raised finally 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
finally 意为“最后”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be finally careful about the whole business。
finally 意为“终于”，2003 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次安顿那件短短的缰绳，副词置于动词之后。
finally 意为“最后”，母亲 2005 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Finally, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年，牧人最后在圈栏安顿那件短短的缰绳；牧场里人人都说那是头一回。（Finally, …）
雨季到来之前，牧人已经终于安顿那件短短的缰绳。（had finally settled …）
那件短短的缰绳当时终于平静。（finally calm）
保管它的那位邻人在入冬前已经最后把它养过两回。（had finally raised it）
叔叔终于安顿那件短短的缰绳，牧场里没有一个人怀疑。（… finally …）
在那个冬天里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最终于。（the most finally of all of them）
answers: Finally, in 1993 the herder settled the rope at the pen.
Before the December rains the herder had finally settled the rope.
The neighbour who kept it had finally raised it twice before the winter came.
He settled the rope finally in the rain, and nobody in the pasture doubted it.
Of all who did it that winter, he did it finally at once.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: Finally, in 1993 the herder settled the rope, and nobody forgot it.
Before the December rains the herder had finally settled the rope.
The rope was finally calm, or so the ledger says.
The neighbour had finally raised it twice before the winter came.
